data.title: 牧濑红莉栖 · 雨夜十字路口的并肩轻语
data.description: 细雨淅沥的秋叶原中央通十字路口，漫天动漫招牌霓虹倒映在湿滑沥青路面上。红莉栖与身边的人合撑一把黑伞，微微侧头咬唇，两颊泛起羞涩微红。
data.location: rainy Tokyo pedestrian crosswalk illuminated by towering anime billboards and neon store signs
data.action: walking under shared black umbrella, leaning close to partner shoulder, biting lip slightly with a subtle tsundere blush
data.lighting: 霓虹招牌彩光与沥青积水倒影
data.promptProse: Kurisu walks across a rain-slicked Akihabara crosswalk under a shared umbrella, leaning near partner with a guarded, affectionate blush.
data.animaCaption: Vivid neon store signs cast shimmering multi-colored reflections on the wet asphalt around their shared umbrella.
